tikas.simpleEn: …than whom nothing is weller 29, ever-going 30, Śiva's-beloved 31… (continues: the 108-name hymn — next).

tikas.author: Pāṭhabheda-ṭippaṇī
tikas.simpleEn: Name-gloss 32–79: God-mother 32, thought 33, jewel-loving 34, all-knowing 35, Dakṣa's daughter 36, Dakṣa-rite-breaker 37, leaf-unclad (who ate not even leaves in penance) 38, many-hued (many-colored) 39, rosy (red-hued) 40, rose-holding (wearing rose or red flowers) 41, silk-robed (silk-wearing) 42, sweet-anklet-gladdened (pleased wearing sweet-sounding anklets) 43, beyond-measure-valiant (boundlessly brave) 44, fierce (harsh to demons) 45, lovely 46, gods'-lovely 47, forest-Durgā 48, elephant-goddess 49, Mātaṅga-sage-praised 50, Brahmā's-power 51, Śiva's 52, Indra's 53, Kumāra's 54, Viṣṇu's 55, Caṇḍikā 56, Vārāhī 57, Fortune 58, man-formed 59, spotless 60, uplifting 61, knowing 62, doing 63, daily 64, thought-giving 65, manifold 66, much-loving 67, all-vehicles-riding 68, Niśumbha-Śumbha-killing 69, buffalo-demon-crushing 70, Madhu-Kaiṭabha-slaying 71, Caṇḍa-Muṇḍa-wiping 72, all-demons-destroying 73, all-giants-slaying 74.

tikas.author: Pāṭhabheda-ṭippaṇī
tikas.simpleEn: Name-gloss 80–108: maiden 80, one-maiden 81, girl 82, young woman 83, striver 84, unripe 85, ripe 86, old-mother 87, strength-giving 88, big-bellied 89, loose-haired 90, dread-formed 91, hugely-strong 92, fire-flamed 93, fierce-faced 94, death-night 95, penance-doing 96, Nārāyaṇī 97, kindly-Kālī 98, Viṣṇu-illusion 99, ocean-bellied 100, Śiva-messenger 101, dreadful 102, endless (undying) 103. (Continues: supreme Queen — next.)

tikas.author: विनाशरहिता
tikas.simpleEn: …endless (undying) 103, supreme Queen 104, Kātyāyanī 105, sun-goddess 106, seen-face 107, Brahman-voicing 108 (verses 2–15).

tikas.author: Bhāṣya (untagged)
tikas.simpleEn: …and at the end, freedom forever. (Verse 17.) Then: worshipping a maiden, picturing goddess-queen of gods, love-worshipping, then reading the hundred-eight-name (18); such a doer wins perfection from even the best gods (19, continues next).

tikas.author: Bhāṣya (untagged)
tikas.simpleEn: …ever wearing it, becomes Śiva-like (freedom-formed). (Verse 20.)

tikas.author: Bhāṣya (untagged)
tikas.simpleEn: The 32-name garland opens: Durgā, hardship-pain-quieter, hardship-word-remover… (continues: the gods' prayer and the Goddess's answer — next).

tikas.author: Pāṭhabheda-ṭippaṇī
tikas.simpleEn: Garland-gloss 1–13: Durgā 1, hardship-pain-quieter 2, hardship-word-remover 3, hardship-cutter 4, hardship-doer 5, hardship-destroyer 6, hardship-uplifter 7, hardship-killer 8, hardship-taker 9, hardship-wisdom-giver 10, hardship-demon-world-wildfire 11, hard-to-reach 12, hard-to-behold 13… (continues).

tikas.author: Bhāṣya (untagged)
tikas.simpleEn: Old quoted verse: make my chanting awake and perfect, O great Goddess! (Verse 3.)

tikas.author: Bhāṣya (untagged)
tikas.simpleEn: Old quoted verse: Dhāṃ Dhīṃ Dhūṃ-formed wife of matted-locked Śiva… (Verse 6.)

tikas.author: Bhāṣya (untagged)
tikas.simpleEn: …creation-formed by Aiṃ-sound, guarding by Hrīṃ-sound… (continues: Klīṃ-formed desire — next).

tikas.author: Bhāṣya (untagged)
tikas.simpleEn: …Goddess, 'Śāṃ Śīṃ Śū'-formed, do my good. (Verse 6.)

tikas.author: Bhāṣya (untagged)
tikas.simpleEn: Fruit-note: daily dawn-reading of this hymn destroys every blocking trouble; Kuñjikā-hymn plus Goddess-hymn with Saptashatī-reading wins top perfection. Then the inner senses: killing is lust-anger-killing, charming is chosen-god-charming, mastering is mind-mastering, stilling is senses' turning from objects, expelling is freedom-aching struggle — all succeed by serving this hymn for that aim.

tikas.author: ऐसा पूछने लगे
tikas.simpleEn: …so they began asking. (Verse 1.)

tikas.author: Bhāṣya (untagged)
tikas.simpleEn: …great elements too are I. This whole seen world is I. (Verse 3.)

tikas.author: प्रकृति और उससे भिन्न
tikas.simpleEn: …nature and non-nature too am I. Below, above, sideways too am I. (Verse 4.)

tikas.author: Bhāṣya (untagged)
tikas.simpleEn: Glory-note: the Atharvaveda sings this Goddess-Atharva-top's greatness hugely — so though not counted among Saptashatī's six limbs, reading it by Atharvaveda rule profits hugely; hence it is seated here.

tikas.author: Bhāṣya (untagged)
tikas.simpleEn: Old quoted verse: Her fire-hued, penance-blazing, sun-born, rite-fruit-tasted — to Durgā Goddess we go for shelter; to demon-killer, salutation. (Verse 9.)

tikas.author: Bhāṣya (untagged)
tikas.simpleEn: …Wide-striding Viṣṇu, Brahmā, Prajāpati — I hold them. (Verse 6.)

tikas.author: Bhāṣya (untagged)
tikas.simpleEn: …to the settler of great ones in their duties, the Gracious, salutation forever. To balanced-state-formed blessed Goddess, salutation. Disciplined, we bow to Her. (Verse 8.)

tikas.author: Bhāṣya (untagged)
tikas.simpleEn: …the speech-formed blessing Goddess, pleased with fine praise, draw near us. (Verse 10.)

tikas.author: सती
tikas.simpleEn: …sin-destroying, welfare-doing blessed Goddess we salute. (Verse 11.) Then: Mahālakṣmī we know, all-power-formed we picture — may She urge us in that (wisdom-focus). (Verse 12.)

tikas.author: Bhāṣya (untagged)
tikas.simpleEn: Great gloss on the code-mantra: Śiva-power-non-different-formed, Brahmā-Viṣṇu-Śiva-souled, Sarasvatī-Lakṣmī-Gaurī-formed, impure-mixed-pure-worship-formed, same-tasting Śiva-power-formed Brahman-nature's doubt-free wisdom-giving, all-truth-formed great Tripura-beauty — such is this mantra's heart-sense. This mantra is the crown-jewel of all mantras, famed in mantra-lore as Pañcadaśī and the rest, as holy lore. Its six senses — heart-sense, word-sense, tradition-sense, world-sense, mystery-sense, truth-sense — the 'Eternal-sixteen-ocean' book tells; and 'Worship-mystery' and other books show many more senses. In scripture too these mantras come now as own-form-speaking, now as pointing, now as pointed-pointing, and somewhere with letters shown apart, tangled-knowingly told — hence know how secret and weighty these mantras are.

tikas.author: मन्त्रद्रष्टा ऋषि कहते हैं-
tikas.simpleEn: The seer who saw the mantra says: She alone is the eight Vasus… (continues: eleven Rudras, twelve suns — next).

tikas.author: Bhāṣya (untagged)
tikas.simpleEn: Code-line quoted: sun, unwrong-ear-drop-joined, from ṭa the third. (Verse 20.)

tikas.author: Bhāṣya (untagged)
tikas.simpleEn: Mantra-sense quoted: O consciousness-formed Mahāsarasvatī! O being-formed Mahālakṣmī! O bliss-formed Mahākālī! To win Brahman-wisdom we all picture You ever. O Mahākālī-Mahālakṣmī-Mahāsarasvatī-formed Caṇḍikā, salutation to You. Open the ignorance-rope's tight knot and free me.

tikas.author: Bhāṣya (untagged)
tikas.simpleEn: …destroyer of great fears, queller of great hardships, very mercy-formed — I bow to You, great Goddess. (Verse 22.)

tikas.author: Bhāṣya (untagged)
tikas.simpleEn: …in words, wisdom (sense)-formed indwelling; in knowings, 'beyond-consciousness'; in voids, 'void-witness'; and than whom naught is higher — famed as Durgā. (Verse 24.)

tikas.author: बार
tikas.simpleEn: …108 chantings and the rest is its fore-rite. Whoever reads ten times is freed of sins that very moment and crosses great hardships by Her grace. (Verse 26.)

tikas.author: Bhāṣya (untagged)
tikas.simpleEn: Old note: for holy-lore seekers four twilights are a must — and the fourth twilight falls at midnight. (Continues: appendix — next.)
